title: Steel Pickaxe
body:
"Tall, forged with 100% steel.. Yeah, I have nothing for this, I ran out of descriptions."

Description

Tall Steel Pickaxe is a pickaxe sold at The Oak Depot for $5,000. Despite the fact that Tall Steel Axe once had a short version of it, Tall Steel Pickaxe never had one.

A nice and affordable choice for intermediate players.

Appearance

Tall Steel Pickaxe is a tall hatchet made out of wood and steel. It's headpiece is dark gray in color and uses the default legacy metal texture. Handle, like any other axe, is made out of dark brown wood with default legacy wood material applied to it.

Trivia

  • It's axe counterpart is Tall Steel Axe.
